level1.title: Peter and Paul
level1.story: Jesus asked, "Who do you say I am?" Peter said, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God!" Jesus said, "You are Peter, the rock. On this rock I will build My Church."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you tell others about Jesus?
level1.prayer: Sts. Peter and Paul, pray for us. Amen.

level2.title: Upon This Rock
level2.story: Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi and asked His disciples, "Whom do men say that the Son of man is?" Then He asked, "But whom do you say that I am?" Simon Peter answered, "Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God." Jesus said, "Blessed art thou, Simon," for the Father had revealed this to him. "Thou art Peter; and upon this rock I will build My church... And I will give to thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven."
level2.keyLine: Thou art Peter; and upon this rock I will build my church.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do we pray for the Pope?
What can we learn from Peter's and Paul's conversions?
actions: Pray for the Pope and bishops
Read a letter of St. Paul
level2.prayer: Lord, keep Your Church strong on the rock. Amen.
